terms.gloss: a narrow pass through hills or forest
evidence: Caes. BC 1.37: Pȳrēnaeōs saltūs occupārī jubet (Lewis & Short)
Liv. 42.53: saltū angustō superātīs montibus (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The same word is also a woodland pasture; in this sense, a pass or ravine, it is Caesar’s and Livy’s (Lewis & Short).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
